reviews.comment: Mrs. Hotz understands public speaking concepts and provides feedback, but the compressed course schedule made unclear expectations difficult to adjust to. I struggled with understanding the difference between acceptable notes/slides and a manuscript until late in the course. More early guidance would benefit students.
Makes it unnecessarily hard and if you have to give it your everything no matter how busy you are to get the A. More than 3 unexcused and she will drop your grade down a letter grade.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Group projects--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: She actually makes the class so much harder than it needs to be. I had her class at 8 am, and her attitude made everything so much worse. The only reason I got up in the mornings was because if you have more than three unexcused absences, she will drop your grade by a letter. She is an extremely strict grader and can be lowkey rude.

Prof Hotz makes this class heavy and excessive. Main group project was difficult to figure out. Her guidelines are strict but don't have direction; we knew what to do, but couldn't figure out how to do it correctly. Make sure to follow the rubrics exactly because its how she grades and you will fail for missing one part of it.
Prepare to study and attendance is mandatory

I loved Professor Hotz, she is very caring and wants her students to do well. She very clearly states what she expects of us in the class, which I greatly appreciated. Overall I loved this class and hope she does good in the future!

She can be a harsh grader, but this was her first-semester teaching, so she was learning the class structure along with the rest of us. She really wants every student to succeed, and if you do your work and go into office hours when needed, you should be fine. She took every suggestion to heart and worked hard to make the class enjoyable!

She is a hard grader & tough professor, but this is also her first semester teaching a class, so I want to give her some grace. Def my hardest class this semester. It's a class that takes a lot of outside preparation to succeed in her class, but she is so sweet and kind. The service project was so fun and a cool opportunity! Just do the work!
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Group projects--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Treats students like they're in 2nd grade. A group comm class is annoying but required credit, says she's the best prof for 210 but I disagree. I would never take her again. Treats this 2nd year college class like its elementary, couldn't stand it.
